project.name: Inspecto - Action Requests (optional)
project.description:
OPTIONAL add-on module (MODULE-REORG-P7, 2026-10-08): the Action Requests add-on of plan section 8a. Four-eyes approved outbound calls: an Incident or Case (any linked subject) raises a request, a second person approves it, and the dispatcher sends it with bounded retries under ONE idempotency key. The routes (/action-requests*), the store (a signed JSON file per request under action-requests/ in the write root - NOT an operational-store family), the dispatcher, and the Decision Rule invoke-api consequence. Package com.gamma.actionrequests.
Contributed through seams only: com.gamma.spi.http.RouteModule (feature id "actionRequests") and com.gamma.decision.ConsequenceProvider (invoke-api). It reaches its subjects only through com.gamma.control.LinkedSubjectProvider (inspecto-ops contributes incident and case), so this module does NOT depend on inspecto-ops; the base approver-eligibility check (com.gamma.control.ApproverCheck), the approver roster and the Pending Change hold stay in the core and work with this module absent. It REQUIRES the notify-channels provider for the outbound wire (WebhookSinkTransport); without it creating a request answers 503.
Bundled from the Professional edition up (the Standard, Professional, Enterprise and Preview profiles). THIN: no shade, no sidecar classifier. Built only under the edition profiles, so a routine "mvn -o clean test" (= Personal) never compiles it.
